sentences.text: Kendrickichthys was an extinct arthrodire placoderm that lived during the Early Frasnian stage of the Late Devonian period.
Fossils of this animal have been found in the Gogo Formation in the Kimberley region of Australia.
Researchers believed Kendrickichthys was durophagous, meaning it preyed on hard-shelled creatures like mollusks.
The type species of the genus Kendrickichthys is Kendrickichthys cavernosus, described by Dennis and Miles in 1980.
Kendrickichthys is a basal member of the clade Aspinothoracidi, which is part of the major clade Pachyosteomorphi within Eubrachythoraci.
The parent group of Kendrickichthys is the family Mylostomatidae.
Kendrickichthys lived from 382.31 to 372.15 million years ago during the Frasnian stage.
